items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a book called Stick Control. It was written by George Lawrence Stone, I think is the name.

ctx.x: Let’s go to the drums. You start getting interested. You get a drum set. Who are your first teachers, and what are they teaching you?

My first teacher was a drummer by the name of James Black who I later found out was my father’s partner in crime as far as music goes. At that time, what I learned from James was fundamentals, such as the book, which I later discovered was the bible of drum books, or the J. S. Bach drum books, if you will, a book called Stick Control. It was written by George Lawrence Stone, I think is the name. It’s one of those very fundamental books that always – it always helps, because if you want to get grounded, you just…
